mentions.name: Automated Test Equipment (KiCad)
mentions.description: This is an automated test equipment build designed in KiCad, combining four voltmeters with four gain settings, four ammeters with four shunts, and four regulated voltage sources. It is currently being assembled, tested, and calibrated.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've designed my first automated test equipment (4 voltmeters with 4 gains, 4 ammeters with 4 shunts, 4 regulated voltage sources) in kicad and now I'm slowly assembling it, testing and calibrating
